basis: Corrected 2026-08-02: per-post data IS available via get_post_analytics and get_cached_post_analytics (only get_history 400s). 13 real per-post rows now in performance-log.jsonl. See Analytics/2026-08-02-per-post-analysis.md.

dial_back.why: S2 depends on verified chain numbers and the network policy still returns 403 for every chain and USDA source. Generating it would mean guessing numbers, which the guardrails forbid.

recut_note: No winners can be named: per-post data does not exist. The 3 re-cut slots become experiments this week, per WEEKLY-LOOP.md Phase 2.
experiments: Comment-first CTAs on the majority of posts until the comment count is non-zero. Zero comments on ~6,900 views is the single clearest failure in the W31 report.
Three brand-film videos in the 20:00 slot: does production value convert reach that carousels are not converting?
Five rotating layout templates at 4 posts/day, watching for any reach penalty that would suggest the grid reads as templated.
verdict_note: No series has the 2-week minimum sample with per-post data, so no scale/iterate/kill verdict is honest yet. S2 is blocked on network access rather than performance.

cadence.note: Raised from 3/day to 4/day by Connor on 2026-08-02, overriding the ceiling in CLAUDE.md. Spacing held at 4h, which is what the Jul 22 incident actually punished. Instagram and Facebook are 0 because they are not linked in Upload-Post, not by choice.

notes: Corrects the W31 report's claim that per-post rows were unavailable and its claim that the reach recovery was back-catalogue compounding. Neither was true.

format_findings.video_vs_photo: TikTok video n=1 got 1 view; photo n=9 median 287. Strong direction, weak sample.
format_findings.reach_is_flat: 8 of 9 photo posts landed 104-462, six in a 281-305 band. Reach is near-fixed at this account size, so views will not discriminate between posts. Judge on likes-per-view and comments.
format_findings.hard_zero: 'POV: the app made you feel worse than the food did' took 0 views on TikTok while the same concept took 34 on YouTube. Read as suppression of a hook that leads with the product harming the user. Do not write those.
format_findings.untracked_posts: 5 of 10 TikTok posts are not in this repo; video_count went 17 to 36 since Jul 25. A second system is posting to the account. Attribution is unreliable until that is identified.
